import csv

            ('Volume discount, agreement 3', '1', '-37.00', '-37.00'),
        ],
        'printed_subtotal': '2877.18',
        'printed_tax': '155.28',
        'printed_total': '3032.46'
    },
    '003093': {
        'vendor': 'Iris Field Services',
        'items': [
            ('Site survey, area 3', '1', '471.50', '471.50'),
            ('Travel time, route 3', '2.25', '64.80', '145.80'),
            ('Calibration standard, set 3', '2', '37.25', '74.50'),
            ('Additional sensor mounts, revised scope 3', '4', '18.95', '75.80'),
            ('Cable assemblies, shielded, length 3 m', '5', '11.40', '57.00'),
            ('Previously billed visit credit, ticket 3', '1', '-27.00', '-27.00'),
        ],
        'printed_subtotal': '797.60',
        'printed_tax': '91.64',
        'printed_total': '889.25'
    }
}

# Write items.csv
with open('items.csv', 'w', newline='') as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f)
    writer.writerow(['invoice_id', 'vendor', 'description', 'quantity', 'unit_price', 'line_amount'])
    
    for invoice_id, data in sorted(invoices.items()):
        vendor = data['vendor']
        for description, qty, unit_price, line_amount in data['items']:
            writer.writerow([invoice_id, vendor, description, qty, unit_price, line_amount])

# Write reconciliation.csv
with open('reconciliation.csv', 'w', newline='') as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f)
    writer.writerow(['invoice_id', 'subtotal', 'tax', 'printed_total', 'computed_total', 'difference', 'status'])
    
    for invoice_id, data in sorted(invoices.items()):
        # Compute subtotal from line items
        subtotal = sum(Decimal(item[3]) for item in data['items'])
        
        # Get printed values
        printed_subtotal = Decimal(data['printed_subtotal'])
        printed_tax = Decimal(data['printed_tax'])
        printed_total = Decimal(data['printed_total'])
        
        # Compute total
        computed_total = subtotal + printed_tax
        
        # Calculate difference
        difference = computed_total - printed_total
        
        # Determine status
        status = 'matched' if difference == 0 else 'discrepancy'
        
        writer.writerow([
            invoice_id,
            f'{subtotal:.2f}',
            f'{printed_tax:.2f}',
            f'{printed_total:.2f}',
            f'{computed_total:.2f}',
            f'{difference:.2f}',
            status
        ])

print("Extraction complete!")
print("\nReconciliation summary:")

# Display reconciliation results
for invoice_id, data in sorted(invoices.items()):
    subtotal = sum(Decimal(item[3]) for item in data['items'])
    printed_tax = Decimal(data['printed_tax'])
    computed_total = subtotal + printed_tax
    printed_total = Decimal(data['printed_total'])
    difference = computed_total - printed_total
    
    print(f"Invoice {invoice_id}: {'MATCHED' if difference == 0 else 'DISCREPANCY'}")
    if difference != 0:
        print(f"  Difference: {difference:.2f}")
EOF
